response.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT event_status, amount - spent AS leftover FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND spent IS NOT NULL), o AS (SELECT AVG(leftover) AS overall_avg FROM d) SELECT d.event_status, AVG(d.leftover) AS avg_leftover, AVG(d.leftover) - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM d CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.event_status, o.overall_avg
